bg.$description: Solid raised surface for the fullscreen dialog.

bg-image.$description: Optional image over the fullscreen fill.

backdrop-filter.$description: Complete backdrop filter for the fullscreen surface.

header-height.$description: Minimum block size of the fullscreen header.

radius.$description: M3 dialog container shape: md.sys.shape.corner.extra-large (28dp) via the material3 radius scale.

padding.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for padding.

gap.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for the gap between its footer actions.

min-width.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for min width (surface size scale; to be refined in Fase M3).

max-width.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for max width (surface size scale; to be refined in Fase M3).

bg.$description: Material 3 color used by the dialog component for background.

fg.$description: Material 3 color used by the dialog component for foreground.

border.$description: Material 3 border used by the dialog component for border.

shadow.$description: M3 dialog container elevation: md.sys.elevation.level3 via ki.elevation.e3 (replaces the migrated approximation).

backdrop-bg.$description: Material 3 color used by the dialog component for backdrop background.

font-size.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for heading font size.

font-weight.$description: Material 3 font weight used by the dialog component for heading font weight.

line-height.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for heading line height.

padding-block-start.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for heading section padding block start: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-block-end.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for heading section padding block end: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-inline.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for heading section padding inline: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-block-start.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for body section padding block start: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-block-end.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for body section padding block end: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-inline.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for body section padding inline: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-block-start.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for footer section padding block start: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-block-end.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for footer section padding block end: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

padding-inline.$description: Material 3 dimension used by the dialog component for footer section padding inline: one 24dp container padding, 20dp between sections, no dividers.

width.$description: Material 3 dialogs draw no section dividers.
